o: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

v.n: Anya Taylor-Joy & Drew Starkey Play "All In or Fold"

eps.o: After a wild night in Vegas, Lucky wakes up to discover her world has been turned upside down.
Seeking shelter, Lucky takes refuge with an unsuspecting family. Priscilla visits Lucky's father.
Lucky tries to track down Cary—and her money. Agent Rand investigates Lucky's moves.
As Lucky confronts betrayal, old grudges take a back seat to a deadly chase.
On the run again, Lucky makes a lucrative discovery. Agent Rand devises a plan.

eps.t: Wherever You Go, There You Are
eps.o: Lucky must face her past while planning for her future.
Everything is on the line as Lucky navigates an explosive confrontation.
